milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because when a lectern is mined it always drops itself as an item (100% drop rate, no silk touch needed). The player starts without a lectern in inventory, so finding one there confirms the lectern was successfully mined. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a wooden hoe (2 oak_planks + 2 sticks on a crafting table) places the result into the player's inventory. The player starts without a wooden_hoe, so its presence confirms successful crafting. This is the preferred rule type for craft tasks since the crafted item ends up in inventory.
